title: A and B should NEVER share any data between one another. B should never read As writes, etc.

items.content: Map every channel through which arm A and arm B can share data
Per-arm prompt-cache salt: ModelRequest.cache_salt filled by kernel, applied in Anthropic/OpenRouter/OpenAI/ChatGPT request builders so the first cacheable prefix differs per arm
Per-arm Gate isolation: frozen GateLive snapshot + own seeded RNG per arm; compare runs do not feed the live table during the compare
Sandbox: per-run TMPDIR and tool caches, drop shared /tmp, read allowlist that hides sibling copies and other compares
Review all three changes + fmt/clippy/test gates
